cqa_tuples.target_criteria: Must state that GBN receiver discards out-of-order packets and only uses cumulative ACKs for the last in-order packet.
acceptable_variants: GBN only acknowledges the last correctly received in-order packet
cqa_tuples.partial_credit_rule: 0.5 marks if only mentions discarding or only mentions cumulative ACK.
cqa_tuples.source_rubric_span: GBN receiver: discard out-of-order / only cumulative ACK of last in-order; no gap buffering.
cqa_tuples.source_reference_span: In GBN the receiver discards out-of-order packets and only cumulatively acknowledges the last in-order packet; it does not buffer gaps.

cqa_tuples.target_criteria: Must state that SR receiver buffers out-of-order packets and uses individual ACKs or NAKs.
cqa_tuples.partial_credit_rule: 0.5 marks if only mentions buffering or only mentions individual ACKs.
cqa_tuples.source_rubric_span: SR receiver: buffer out-of-order correct packets; individual ACK (or NAK) of missing packet.
cqa_tuples.source_reference_span: In Selective Repeat the receiver buffers out-of-order correctly received packets and individually acknowledges them (or NAKs the missing one) so only the lost packet needs recovery.

cqa_tuples.target_criteria: Must distinguish that GBN retransmits all packets in the window while SR retransmits only the missing packet.
cqa_tuples.partial_credit_rule: 0.5 marks if only describes GBN or only describes SR behavior correctly.
cqa_tuples.source_rubric_span: Sender: GBN retransmits lost + all later window packets; SR retransmits only missing packet(s).
cqa_tuples.source_reference_span: On timeout/loss, GBN retransmits the lost packet and all subsequent packets in the window; SR retransmits only the missing/unacked packet(s).

cqa_tuples.target_criteria: Must identify that SR is preferred for lossy links/bandwidth efficiency, acknowledging the cost of complexity or buffering.
acceptable_variants: SR is better for high loss links
SR saves bandwidth but requires more memory
cqa_tuples.partial_credit_rule: 0.5 marks if mentions the benefit (efficiency) but ignores the cost (complexity) or vice versa.
cqa_tuples.source_rubric_span: Trade-off: SR preferred when retransmissions are costly / lossy links; mentions complexity or buffer cost of SR as the downside is OK.
cqa_tuples.source_reference_span: SR is preferred when bandwidth is scarce or loss is non-negligible, because it avoids unnecessary retransmissions — at the cost of more complex buffering and individual ACKs at the receiver.
